build_training_parser: build an argparse parser with dataset, distributed training, model, optimization, and checkpointing args for fairseq training
build_generation_parser: build an argparse parser with dataset, generation, and optional interactive args for fairseq inference
parse_args_and_arch: parse command line args and dynamically add model-specific and registry-specific arguments then post-process
build_eval_lm_parser: build an argparse parser with dataset, distributed training, and language model evaluation args for fairseq
build_validation_parser: build an argparse parser with dataset, distributed training, and common evaluation args for fairseq validation
